rationale: All demonstrations erase colour 6 to background 8, preserve anchors 1, and paint 7 after one rotation (-dc,dr). In the first demonstration, (5,5) rotates around (8,5) to (8,2), while (8,8) rotates around (8,11) to (11,11). Global one-to-one assignment sends the equidistant second source to the right anchor rather than reusing the left. Aligned matching and rejecting out-of-bounds rotations are consistent with every example.
